title: Trends in International Arms Transfers, 2025
discussion_signal: SIPRI relays that the largest recipients of major arms in 2021–25 included Ukraine, India, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Pakistan, framing transfer concentration as a measurable feature of the global arms system rather than proof of political control.
linked_research_question: When arms-transfer dominance creates allied dependence, what can be inferred about material leverage—and what remains unproven about political control?
limits: The post summarizes transfer volumes and recipients, not political control
Transfer volume is not equivalent to operational dependence
